ID number
Counter value
ID 2307
Energy Trip Counter Format
The energy trip counter format gives the position of the decimal point in the value of the Energy Trip Counter.
· 40 = 4 digits, 0 fractional digits
•
41 = 4 digits, 1 fractional digit
· 42 = 4 digits, 2 fractional digits
· 43 = 4 digits, 3 fractional digits
Example
· 0.001 kWh (Format = 43)
•
100.0 kWh (Format = 41)
· 10.00 MWh (Format = 42)
ID number
Counter value
ID 2309
Energy Trip Counter Unit
The energy trip counter unit gives the unit for the value of the Energy Trip Counter.
•
0 = kWh
•
1 = MWh
•
2 = GWh
· 3 = TWh
· 4 = PWh
ID number
Counter value
ID 2312
Energy Trip Counter Reset
To reset the energy trip counter, use the PC, the control panel, or the fieldbus. When using the PC or the control panel, reset the
counter in the Diagnostics menu. When using the fieldbus, set a rising edge to ID 2312 Energy Trip Counter Reset.
